project_type: Roblox Luau game (Battle Pets - Pet Simulator)
build_system: Python script tools/generate_rbxlx.py regenerates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx from src/ tree
test_framework: No automated test framework - validation is via Lua syntax check and successful rbxlx generation
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py to regenerate the place file. 2. Verify no errors in output. 3. Verify BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx was updated.
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is generated from src/ by running python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py
environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio available. Validation limited to Lua syntax checking and rbxlx generation.
contribution_requirements: After code changes, run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py to regenerate the .rbxlx file
key_patterns: Server-authoritative architecture. Remotes folder at ReplicatedStorage.Remotes. RemoteFunctions used for request/response patterns. Server validates all actions. PetController uses self._remotes for remote access. ZoneService is a module with class-style functions.
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/Services/ - server services (ZoneService, PetService, etc). src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ - client controllers (PetController, UIController, etc). src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared config/data modules. tools/ - build scripts.
